articles.title: tBTC bridge partially resumes as $120M Aave reserve remains frozen
articles.snippet: Threshold halted its tBTC bridge on Oct. 30 as operators addressed a critical Linux kernel vulnerability that could allow attackers to execute code on unpatched servers.

articles.title: This Bitcoin Developer’s Idea Would Make Quantum Attacks a Losing Bet
articles.snippet: Cory Fields wants future quantum attackers to post Bitcoin as collateral before touching vulnerable wallets, giving prepared owners a chance to recover their coins and collect a potentially costly penalty.

articles.title: $3.1B in Stolen Binance Crypto Has Yet to Be Laundered: Elliptic
articles.snippet: The attackers have used more than 20,000 wallets on 16 blockchains so far, but the bulk of the stolen ETH and Bitcoin hasn't moved.
